ProceduralRecipe.rule: A recipe is immutable by version. Changing generator algorithm or interpretation requires a new generator/recipe version or explicit migration.

SemanticAnchor.rule: stable_key is semantic identity; parent_anchor must reference another anchor in the same recipe or be null.

ReconstructionReceipt.rule: Receipt records reconstruction evidence only; it does not authorize production release.

invariants: same root_seed + same ordered key_parts => same seed_string
different semantic key paths => different framed seed_string before RNG hashing
adding/reordering unrelated sibling branches does not change an existing branch seed_string
no Date.now(), Math.random(), sequence index, sibling count, prior draw count, or UI order participates
